TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Southern Papua
DATE 14 November 2028 · 1730 local
SIDE USA
WINDOW 80 min, closes at 120
A-10C Thunderbolt II. Photo: U.S. Air Force photo/Airman 1st Class Alesia Goosic · Public domain · cropped
"Combat is unforgiving, and victory belongs to the side that adapts faster, fights harder, and endures longer."
- Gen. Eric M. Smith, Commandant of the Marine Corps, 2025
SOUTHERN PAPUA, last light. With the Biak airlift over, relief moves by road, and the column has stopped twice today because the road is covered from a ridge nobody has cleared.

A US package has been allocated for one evening: Apaches on the road, a Warthog pair on the ridge, a gunship on the loiter and a Strike Eagle holding the long shots. A Polish F-16 detachment transiting to the theatre has been pulled in for escort.
Two Marine Ospreys are bringing the airhead's first lift in behind the column, and the ridge covers their approach as surely as it covers the road.

Get the column - the relief truck is the column - to the airstrip. The gunship is usable only while no fighter radar is watching this sector: if the J-16 comes up, pull the gunship the moment its radar does. Losing the gunship ends the operation.
Lieutenant Colonel R. Okafor, US ground-support package
COMMANDER'S INTENT
The column reaches the airhead. The road is the corridor; the corridor is the relief. Hold the perimeter open, and bring the gunship home with fuel to spare.
• Get the relief truck to the airstrip
• Do not lose the gunship
• Leave the settlements alone
• Land the Osprey lift at the airstrip

An AH-64E and an AH-64D, two A-10Cs, an AC-130J, an F-15E, a Polish F-16C, a B-2 on a single allocated pass, two MV-22B and an Army MV-75 with the airhead's first lift. Opposing: a J-16, an attack helicopter, a PLA road detachment and a mobile SAM on the ridge.

The planned window is 80 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 40 minutes more; the operation is closed at 120 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
